content2.content: Follow these guidelines to build a robust and user-friendly networking layer.

content4.content: Never perform network requests on the main thread. Always use `async/await` or `Isolates` for heavy parsing.

content6.content: Always set a timeout for your requests. A user shouldn't wait forever for a server that isn't responding.

content8.content: Batch requests together. Avoid frequent polling; use push notifications or WebSockets instead.

content10.content: Use HTTPS for all requests. Implement Certificate Pinning for high-security apps.

content12.content: Adhering to these best practices ensures your app is performant, secure, and respectful of the user's device resources.
